content.user_title: Create Mermaid Diagrams and Design Documents
content.value_statement: Complex systems are difficult to explain consistently. This skill creates structured Mermaid diagrams and design documents from requirements, source code, and configuration.
actual_capabilities: Creates flowchart, sequence, class, entity relationship, state, C4, deployment, and architecture diagrams in Mermaid.
Selects focused reference guides based on the requested diagram, platform, framework, or document type.
Converts source code and configuration patterns into architecture, workflow, deployment, and interaction diagrams.
Provides templates for architecture, API, feature, database, and complete system design documents.
Extracts Mermaid blocks from Markdown and can replace them with generated image references.
Validates and renders Mermaid files as PNG, SVG, or PDF through the local Mermaid CLI.
limitations: Validation and image rendering require a local Mermaid CLI installation.
Code-derived diagrams depend on the source files and architectural context supplied to the agent.
The included scripts do not publish files directly to Confluence, GitHub, or other documentation platforms.
PlantUML-only diagram types require separate tooling and are outside the included rendering scripts.

use_cases.title: Document System Architecture
use_cases.description: Create architecture and deployment views from system requirements, service boundaries, and infrastructure details.

use_cases.title: Visualize Application Code
use_cases.description: Translate framework structure, request flows, data models, and business logic into focused Mermaid diagrams.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technical Design Documents
use_cases.description: Build consistent API, feature, database, or system documents with diagrams ready for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Flowchart
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Mermaid flowchart for [process]. Include the start, main decisions, success path, and failure path.

prompt_templates.title: Diagram a Service Interaction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Mermaid sequence diagram for [request]. Show [actors], important calls, responses, errors, and asynchronous steps.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Codebase to Diagrams
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [repository or files]. Create separate Mermaid diagrams for architecture, runtime flow, data model, and deployment. State assumptions and exclude unsupported details.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Complete Design Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [system, API, feature, or database] design document for [project]. Include scope, requirements, decisions, risks, alternatives, and validated Mermaid diagrams.

output_examples.input: Show the checkout process with payment failure and retry paths.
output_examples.output: A high-contrast activity diagram showing cart review, validation, payment authorization, retry limits, order creation, and failure outcomes.

output_examples.input: Document the login request across the browser, API, identity service, and database.
output_examples.output: A sequence diagram showing credential submission, validation, user lookup, token creation, success responses, and authentication errors.

output_examples.input: Create an API design document for a contact management service.
output_examples.output: A structured design document covering scope, endpoints, authentication, data entities, errors, deployment, decisions, and supporting Mermaid diagrams.

best_practices: Keep each diagram focused on one concept and label assumptions outside the diagram.
Validate Mermaid syntax before publishing or converting diagrams to images.
Load only the guides and framework examples relevant to the requested output.
anti_patterns: Do not combine architecture, deployment, data, and runtime behavior in one crowded diagram.
Do not present inferred implementation details as confirmed facts from the codebase.
Do not rely on Mermaid fences alone when the target platform requires rendered images.

faq.question: Which Mermaid diagram types are supported?
faq.answer: The guides cover flowchart, sequence, class, entity relationship, state, C4, activity, deployment, and architecture diagrams.

faq.question: Can this skill create diagrams from source code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes workflows and examples for Spring Boot, FastAPI, React, Python ETL, Node.js, and Java web applications.

faq.question: Can it create complete design documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Templates cover architecture, API, feature, database, and system design documents.

faq.question: Does image rendering work without additional software?
faq.answer: No. PNG, SVG, and PDF rendering requires Mermaid CLI to be installed locally.

faq.question: Does it upload diagrams to documentation platforms?
faq.answer: No. It prepares Mermaid source and image files, but publishing or uploading requires separate platform tools.

faq.question: How does validation work?
faq.answer: The Python utilities call Mermaid CLI, check its exit status, verify output files, and return troubleshooting guidance when rendering fails.
